statement: Deliberately uncovered behaviors observed on the production service. A known gap is never an approved case and never counts as PASS: translation success, controlled refusal, ambiguity, known gaps, and infrastructure errors are always reported separately. Every observation here was produced by the CLI/the same service path at the recorded SHA and matched an independently authored expectation where one exists.
observationHorizon: Rows record their own observation SHA in observedAtSha and each state move requires an observation at that SHA. Original observations were manual CLI runs on 2026-10-17 at main@caffbd52b5951cccc06708d055574d68486d1a62; later re-observations (e.g. the 2026-10-18 deictic repair, issue #362) carry their own SHA.

gaps.retestPolicy: Closed by the #362 repair: the ADR person-deixis contract is now enforced by approved cases and they are the executable guard. If A1-EN-PL-DEIXIS-0001/0003 or the positive deictic witnesses ever fail or regress to an infrastructure error, re-open this family.
gaps.note: History: at main@caffbd52b5951cccc06708d055574d68486d1a62 this input crashed as status error/INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR exit 1 because valid ADR v1.22 deictic readers failed the event-role bridge validation (PLUGIN_CORE_REFERENCE_INVALID classified as an internal plugin failure). Re-observed 2026-10-18 at the repair SHA: status ambiguous with exactly two explicit ADR v1.22 readings (addressee second/singular and second/plural; English `you` does not resolve number), text null, meaning null, exit 2. Closed as approved cases: A1-EN-PL-DEIXIS-0001 (ambiguity), A1-EN-PL-DEIXIS-0002 (positive en->pl), A1-PL-EN-DEIXIS-0001/0002 (positive pl->en). An infrastructure error was never turned into an approved refusal.

input.text: A girl looks at a house.

gaps.owner: #364 — en.house.1 activation + approved en-fi/fi-en cases (Drugi agent, opencode/GLM)
gaps.retestPolicy: Closed by the #364 repair: the en house lexeme is activated through its empty forms table plus the already-tracked en.noun.regular morphology binding, and both directions are guarded by approved cases. If A1-EN-FI-VISUAL-0001/0002 or A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0001/0002 ever fail, or the event.visual_attention capability regresses to a refusal or an infrastructure error, re-open this family.
gaps.note: History: manifests on both sides declared event.visual_attention implemented, yet at main@caffbd52b5951cccc06708d055574d68486d1a62 both directions refused with LANGUAGE_CONSTRUCTION_UNSUPPORTED exit 2. The earlier '1/6 fi morphology compile coverage' reading was a red herring: fi analysis succeeded once probed directly (fi.noun.talo.type1 already decodes taloa). Root cause was the English data: en.house.1 had no forms key at all, so expandLexemes (js/core/grammar.js:808) dropped the lexeme from both en analysis and en realization; the en.noun.regular morphology binding alone could not activate it. Fixed in PR #370 (merged as main@485ee7cfab51f5d431dd35313df49872dc1abf58). Re-observed 2026-10-18 at that merge SHA: en->fi status ok, text 'Tyttö katsoo taloa.', exit 0, agent/theme indefinite with two unavoidable target-grammar-does-not-mark-definiteness entries. Closed as approved cases: A1-EN-FI-VISUAL-0001 (positive en->fi), A1-EN-FI-VISUAL-0002 (controlled refusal), A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0001 (positive fi->en), A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0002 (controlled refusal). Required check translation-matrix SUCCESS on PR #370 and on main; the refusal diagnostics were never rewritten as capability proof. Side observations recorded on #364: the en no-forms lexeme family with morphology bindings (en.bicycle.1, en.phone.1 and neighbors) stays latent and outside declared capabilities; 'Tytöt katsovat taloja.' parses as plural; 'A girl sees a house.' en->fi refuses with PLUGIN_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE because fi declares only its bounded constructions.

gaps.owner: #364 — en.house.1 activation + approved en-fi/fi-en cases (Drugi agent, opencode/GLM)
gaps.retestPolicy: Closed by the #364 repair: paired with GAP-EN-FI-VISUAL-0003, the fi analysis never needed a change and the end realization is repaired by activating the en house lexeme; the direction is guarded by approved cases. If A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0001/0002 ever fail, or the fi->en capability regresses to a refusal or an infrastructure error, re-open this family.
gaps.note: History: same mismatch as GAP-EN-FI-VISUAL-0003, reverse direction: fi.analyze declared event.visual_attention implemented yet the service refused. Direct probing showed fi analysis produced one clean partitive reading ('Tyttö katsoo taloa.' -> event.visual_attention, agent/theme number singular definiteness unknown); the refusal came from the en realization whose house lexeme was dead (en.house.1 lacked its forms key, so expandLexemes dropped it). Fixed in PR #370 (merged as main@485ee7cfab51f5d431dd35313df49872dc1abf58). Re-observed 2026-10-18 at that merge SHA: fi->en status ok, text 'A girl looks at a house.', exit 0, agent/theme definiteness unknown with two ambiguous source-definiteness-unspecified-target-default entries and the endorsed alternative 'The girl looks at the house.'. Closed as approved cases: A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0001 (positive fi->en), A1-FI-EN-VISUAL-0002 (controlled refusal), A1-EN-FI-VISUAL-0001/0002 (paired en->fi). Required check translation-matrix SUCCESS on PR #370 and on main; neither direction regressed into a fake refusal-based pass.

gaps.retestPolicy: Re-run the CLI on every SHA that touches the pl deictic analysis inventory (languages/pl function forms or grammar deictic reading). This gap may close only by implementing the short accusative clitic analysis and recording approved positive witnesses — never by turning the current bounded refusal into an approved boundary case.
gaps.note: The short accusative clitic `cię` is the unmarked Polish object form at A1, while the pl analysis inventory currently covers only full forms (`mnie`, `ciebie`; explicit subjects `ja`/`ty`). The refusal is bounded and honest (explicit unsupported status, exit 2, no invented meaning), but the sentence is inside the project's stated A1 scope, so it is registered as a product gap rather than an approved case. Discovered while re-observing GAP-EN-PL-DEIXIS-0001 during the #362 repair.
